nuisance_construction.response_magnitude: geometric mean of the two plate-specific gamma L2 norms before pair similarity
nuisance_construction.residual_energy: geometric mean of the two plate-specific residual L2 norms before pair similarity
nuisance_construction.context_overlap: exact shared frozen context mask; constant 50 for pharmacologic fingerprints
nuisance_construction.lineage_composition: frozen context mask lineage proportions; constant for full-context fingerprints
nuisance_construction.scaling: median/MAD using all eligible pairs; zero-MAD columns retained as documented constants

positive_pair_rules.TARGET_FAMILY: share >=1 eligible HGNC family ID and do not have identical non-empty canonical target sets
positive_pair_rules.EXACT_TARGET: identical non-empty canonical molecular target sets (historical BIO-1 definition)

MOA: same broad action and different fine MOA
TARGET_FAMILY: same fine MOA and different family
same broad action and different family
EXACT_TARGET: same target family and different canonical target set
same fine MOA and different canonical target set
same broad action and different canonical target set

nearest_control.distance: Euclidean distance on frozen robust-scaled nuisance features

qap_strata.dose_rule: exact concentration_unit plus log10 concentration tertile; zero/invalid is separate
